hints.title: Duplicate Bitwise Cancellation Property
hints.text: Every integer in the collection appears twice except for one unique element. What bitwise operation cancels identical numbers while preserving the unique value?

hints.title: Involution and Identity Invariant
hints.text: Bitwise xor has properties a xor a equals zero and a xor zero equals a, cancelling all pairs and leaving only the solitary number.

hints.title: Cumulative Bitwise Xor Reduction Procedure
hints.text: Initialize accumulator to 0. Iterate through every integer in the input array, combining it with accumulator using bitwise xor. Return the final accumulated integer.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using auxiliary collections requires O(N) memory, violating the strict O(1) space constraint.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Cumulative bitwise xor reduction runs in linear O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain xor commutative and associative properties clearly (a ^ a = 0 and a ^ 0 = a).
